o.text: Internationalism; likely via Russian автопортре́т (avtoportrét), ultimately from French autoportrait.
From Arabic إِعاشة (ʔiʕāša). Compare Turkish iaşe.
From Proto-Turkic *töle-, Old Anatolian Turkish دوللك (“place where sheep breed”).
Borrowed from Russian чипсы (čipsy), from English chips, plural of chip.
